title: Smart Routing is faster and lower cost, and now routes subagents only (Beta)
body: Smart Routing now routes only subagents, not the first prompt. It costs up to 70% less in internal benchmarks and cuts p90 routing latency from 9 seconds to 2 seconds. Smart Routing for Codex is paused. See [Select models or use Smart Routing](/aws/en/ai-gateway/coding-agent-model-selection).

ref_links.text: Select models or use Smart Routing
